verdict.line: You lose the short trade if he lands his third hit for Darkness Rise before you disengage, but you win the extended fight and the game, posting 52.9% over 2,079 games.

brief.thesis: Neither champion has a built-in combat edge here — Mordekaiser's Obliterate poke and Darkness Rise aura make him the stronger threat in a quick trade, but Fiora's Riposte parry and Duelist sustain flip every fight that runs past the first few seconds. The lane is decided by whether you eat the auto he throws around his pull and ultimate, or parry it.

theirWindow.when: Darkness Rise active, E/Q both up
theirWindow.what: He has bonus damage and move speed plus a full combo — Obliterate into Death's Grasp into autos will out-damage a stand-and-trade. Disengage with E (Burst of Speed)'s move speed stacking instead of fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: his E and Q both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: No pull, no poke reset — this is when double Q (Lunge) and an all-in actually land clean. Hold W (Riposte) for the auto he throws immediately after using E (Death's Grasp) or R (Realm of Death), since that attack is both his damage and his third passive stack.

start.why: 52.6% win rate over 2,343 games and the 91.9% pick — the AD and sustain hold up against his Obliterate poke better than a shield item.

boots.why: 52% win rate, 60.5% pick — Mordekaiser's entire kit is magic damage, so the MR reduces how much Obliterate and Death's Grasp actually take off you.

core.why: First item in the 60.4%-win, 28.3%-pick path — the sustain and wave clear let you shove and reset before he can poke you down.
Second in the top build path — the attack speed and damage spike pairs with E (Burst of Speed) to win the extended trades you're now favored in.
Closes out the 60.4%-win core — damage mitigation that specifically outlasts his Indestructible shield-and-heal in a long fight.

situational.when: you're snowballing lane and want burst into isolated picks instead of a drawn-out duel
their team has additional heavy AP burst beyond Mordekaiser himself
you want the sustain-and-scale path instead of Trinity Force's burst
their jungler or another laner is a physical-damage threat on top of Mordekaiser

runes.keystoneWhy: The 48.7%-win, 13.7%-pick page — stacks through exactly the extended trades Fiora wins once Darkness Rise's burst window has passed. Master-tier Fiora players instead run Press the Attack (49.2% win, 11.8% pick) across 19,496 games; that suits a more aggressive, all-in-first playstyle rather than the sustained-fight approach Conqueror rewards.

summoners.why: 53.4% win rate at a 90.1% pick rate — Ignite punishes his Indestructible heal directly by cutting the healing on the shield he pops. Flash+Teleport (48.9%, 6.8% pick) is the wave-priority alternative if you expect to be shoved and need to reset safely.

playing.title: Bait the auto, not the pull
playing.detail: Hold W (Riposte) for the basic attack he throws right after Death's Grasp or Realm of Death lands. That parry both reflects damage and denies a stack toward his Darkness Rise passive.

playing.title: Track his passive stack count
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs 3 landed attacks or spells on you. Disengage or interrupt before the third hit connects, since the aura after that point wins him the trade outright.

playing.title: Use both Lunge charges
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast a second time within a couple seconds for free. Obliterate hits hardest on a single stationary target, so use the double-dash to keep repositioning through his trades rather than standing still.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: Blade Waltz resets your Duelist stacks on each strike — use it when his E and Q are both down so he can't pull you out or punish you mid-dash.

playing.title: Don't feed his shield
playing.detail: Indestructible banks all damage dealt and taken into a shield he can consume to heal. Avoid long poke exchanges right before he's clearly about to pop it — compress your damage into E (Burst of Speed) windows instead.

playing.title: Disengage with E stacks, not flash
playing.detail: Burst of Speed's move speed stacks on every landed hit or Lunge — use that to walk away once Darkness Rise procs rather than burning Flash every time he goes aggressive.

playing.title: Shove and reset over sieging
playing.detail: Fiora has no AoE disengage to answer Death's Grasp in a group fight. Use your Q poke to push waves and look for side-lane resets instead of forcing stand-still trades near his pull range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the trade-pattern and timing read is our own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to block either Mordekaiser’s (E) or his (R). Do not let him maintain his (P) by keeping your distance while fighting him.
